# AArch64 encoding goldens: instruction | words from clang | relocations.
# The words and relocations are generated by gen_golden_aarch64.py (clang,
# arm64-apple-macos11, or aarch64-linux-gnu after `#@ target elf`); edit only
# the left column and rerun it. Relocations are offset:kind:addend; reloc
# fields are masked when comparing.
